traditions.WLC: בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֗וּא
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
traditions.VUL: In die illa
traditions.KJV: In that day

1.english_reference: there shall be a fountain opened

traditions.WLC: יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח
traditions.LXX: ἔσται πᾶς τόπος διανοιγόμενος
traditions.VUL: erit fons patens
traditions.KJV: there shall be a fountain opened

1.english_reference: to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: לְ בֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּ לְ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: τῷ οἴκῳ Δαυεὶδ καὶ τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: dómui David , et habitántibus Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: לְ חַטַּ֖את וּ לְ נִדָּֽה
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὴν μετακίνησιν καὶ εἰς τὸν χωρισμόν .
traditions.VUL: in ablutiónem peccatóris , et menstruátæ .
traditions.KJV: for sin and for uncleanness .

2.english_reference: And it shall come to pass in that day

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֩ בַ יּ֨וֹם הַ ה֜וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Et erit in die illa ,
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת
traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος σαβαώθ ,
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD of hosts , [ that ]

2.english_reference: I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land

traditions.WLC: אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽ עֲצַבִּים֙ מִן הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ἐξολεθρεύσω τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν εἰδώλων ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: dispérdam nómina idolórum de terra ,
traditions.KJV: I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land ,

2.english_reference: and they shall no more be remembered

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκέτι ἔσται αὐτῶν μνεία ·
traditions.VUL: et non memorabúntur ultra :
traditions.KJV: and they shall no more be remembered :

2.english_reference: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֧ם אֶת הַ נְּבִיאִ֛ים וְ אֶת ר֥וּחַ הַ טֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ψευδοπροφήτας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον ἐξαρῶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: et pseudoprophétas , et spíritum immúndum áuferam de terra .
traditions.KJV: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .

3.english_reference: And it shall come to pass , [ that ] when any shall yet prophesy

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν προφητεύσῃ ἄνθρωπος ἔτι ,
traditions.VUL: Et erit : cum prophetáverit quíspiam ultra ,
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass , [ that ] when any shall yet prophesy ,

3.english_reference: then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָי ו אָבִ֨י ו וְ אִמּ֤ וֹ יֹֽלְדָי ו֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ , οἱ γεννήσαντες αὐτόν
traditions.VUL: dicent ei pater eius , et mater eius , qui genuérunt eum :
traditions.KJV: then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him ,

3.english_reference: Thou shalt not live ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Οὐ ζήσῃ , ὅτι ψευδῆ ἐλάλησας ἐπ᾽ ὀνόματι Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Non vives , quia mendácium locútus es in nómine Dómini :
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt not live ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD :

3.english_reference: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth

traditions.WLC: וּ דְקָרֻ֜ הוּ אָבִ֧י הוּ וְ אִמּ֛ וֹ יֹלְדָ֖י ו בְּ הִנָּבְאֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ συμποδιοῦσιν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ , οἱ γεννήσαντες αὐτόν , ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: et confígent eum pater eius , et mater eius , genitóres eius , cum prophetáverit .
traditions.KJV: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .

4.english_reference: And it shall come to pass in that day

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֣ה בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֗וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
traditions.VUL: Et erit : in die illa
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day , [ that ]

4.english_reference: the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied

traditions.WLC: יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַ נְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵ חֶזְיֹנ֖ וֹ בְּ הִנָּֽבְאֹת֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καταισχυνθήσονται οἱ προφῆται , ἕκαστος ἐκ τῆς ὁράσεως αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ προφητεύειν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: confundéntur prophétæ , unusquísque ex visióne sua cum prophetáverit :
traditions.KJV: the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied ;

4.english_reference: neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνδύσονται δέρριν τριχίνην ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐψεύσαντο .
traditions.VUL: nec operiéntur pállio saccíno , ut mentiántur :
traditions.KJV: neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :

5.english_reference: But he shall say , I [ am ] no prophet

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ Οὐκ εἰμὶ προφήτης ἐγώ ,
traditions.VUL: sed dicet : Non sum prophéta ,
traditions.KJV: But he shall say , I [ am ] no prophet ,

traditions.WLC: אִישׁ עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי
traditions.LXX: διότι ἄνθρωπος ἐργαζόμενος τὴν γῆν ἐγώ εἰμι ,
traditions.VUL: homo agrícola ego sum :
traditions.KJV: I [ am ] an husbandman ;

5.english_reference: for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥ נִי מִ נְּעוּרָֽ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ἐγέννησέν με ἐκ νεότητός μου .
traditions.VUL: quóniam Adam exémplum meum ab adolescéntia mea .
traditions.KJV: for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth .

6.english_reference: And [ one ] shall say unto him , What [ are ] these wounds in thine hands ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔י ו מָ֧ה הַ מַּכּ֛וֹת הָ אֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ πρὸς αὐτόν Τί αἱ πληγαὶ αὗται ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν χειρῶν σου ?
traditions.VUL: Et dicétur ei : Quid sunt plagæ istæ in médio mánuum tuárum ?
traditions.KJV: And [ one ] shall say unto him , What [ are ] these wounds in thine hands ?

6.english_reference: Then he shall answer , [ Those ] with which I was wounded [ in ] the house of my friends

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ Ἃς ἐπλήγην ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ μου .
traditions.VUL: Et dicet : His plagátus sum in domo eórum , qui diligébant me .
traditions.KJV: Then he shall answer , [ Those ] with which I was wounded [ in ] the house of my friends .

7.english_reference: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man [ that is ] my fellow

traditions.WLC: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל רֹעִ י֙ וְ עַל גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: Ῥομφαία , ἐξεγέρθητι ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιμένας μου καὶ ἐπ᾽ ἄνδρα πολίτην μου ,
traditions.VUL: Frámea suscitáre super pastórem meum , et super virum cohæréntem mihi ,
traditions.KJV: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man [ that is ] my fellow ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ ·
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD of hosts :

7.english_reference: smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered

traditions.WLC: הַ֤ךְ אֶת הָֽ רֹעֶה֙ וּ תְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַ צֹּ֔אן
traditions.LXX: πατάξατε τοὺς ποιμένας καὶ ἐκσπάσατε τὰ πρόβατα ,
traditions.VUL: pércute pastórem , et dispergéntur oves :
traditions.KJV: smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered :

7.english_reference: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖ י עַל הַ צֹּעֲרִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάξω τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ τοὺς μικρούς .
traditions.VUL: et convértam manum meam ad párvulos .
traditions.KJV: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones .

8.english_reference: And it shall come to pass , [ that ] in all the land , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֤ה בְ כָל הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Et erunt in omni terra , dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass , [ that ] in all the land , saith the LORD ,

8.english_reference: two parts therein shall be cut off [ and ] die

traditions.WLC: פִּֽי שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔ הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ
traditions.LXX: τὰ δύο μέρη αὐτῆς ἐξολεθρευθήσεται καὶ ἐκλείψει ,
traditions.VUL: partes duæ in ea dispergéntur , et defícient :
traditions.KJV: two parts therein shall be cut off [ and ] die ;

8.english_reference: but the third shall be left therein

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ שְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: τὸ δὲ τρίτον ὑπολειφθήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ ·
traditions.VUL: et tértia pars relinquétur in ea .
traditions.KJV: but the third shall be left therein .

9.english_reference: And I will bring the third part through the fire

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת הַ שְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּ אֵ֔שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διάξω τὸ τρίτον διὰ πυρός ,
traditions.VUL: Et ducam tértiam partem per ignem ,
traditions.KJV: And I will bring the third part through the fire ,

9.english_reference: and will refine them as silver is refined

traditions.WLC: וּ צְרַפְתִּי ם֙ כִּ צְרֹ֣ף אֶת הַ כֶּ֔סֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ πυρώσω αὐτοὺς ὡς πυροῦται τὸ ἀργύριον ,
traditions.VUL: et uram eos sicut úritur argéntum ,
traditions.KJV: and will refine them as silver is refined ,

9.english_reference: and will try them as gold is tried

traditions.WLC: וּ בְחַנְתִּ֖י ם כִּ בְחֹ֣ן אֶת הַ זָּהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ δοκιμῶ αὐτοὺς ὡς δοκιμάζεται τὸ χρυσίον ·
traditions.VUL: et probábo eos sicut probátur aurum .
traditions.KJV: and will try them as gold is tried :

9.english_reference: they shall call on my name , and I will hear them

traditions.WLC: ה֣וּא יִקְרָ֣א בִ שְׁמִ֗ י וַֽ אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ἐπικαλέσεται τὸ ὄνομά μου , κἀγὼ ἐπακούσομαι αὐτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Ipse vocábit nomen meum , et ego exáudiam eum .
traditions.KJV: they shall call on my name , and I will hear them :

9.english_reference: I will say , It [ is ] my people

traditions.WLC: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣ י ה֔וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρῶ Λαός μου οὗτός ἐστιν ,
traditions.VUL: Dicam : Pópulus meus es :
traditions.KJV: I will say , It [ is ] my people :

9.english_reference: and they shall say , The LORD [ is ] my God

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐρεῖ Κύριος ὁ θεός μου .
traditions.VUL: et ipse dicet : Dóminus Deus meus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall say , The LORD [ is ] my God .
